name: redis
description: Base brick: a Redis server that provides the "cache" capability. Each consumer gets its own user, limited to the keys and channels that start with its name and a colon (REDIS_PREFIX); the administration commands and the search commands are not given to it (D41). Redis 8 is licensed under RSALv2, SSPLv1 or AGPLv3, at your choice: read it before you run it for others.

services.name: server
args: set -eu; umask 077; acl=/data/users.acl; touch "$acl"; hash=$(printf %s "$REDIS_PASSWORD" | sha256sum | cut -c1-64); { echo "user default on sanitize-payload #$hash ~* &* +@all"; grep -v "^user default " "$acl" || true; } > "$acl.new"; mv "$acl.new" "$acl"; chown -R redis:redis /data; exec docker-entrypoint.sh redis-server --dir /data --aclfile "$acl"
